Title: Muse — Your Personal AI Agent

URL Source: https://muse.ai/

Markdown Content:
Log in

![Image 1: Muse](https://muse.ai/images/landing/brand/muse-logo.svg)
# Muse, AI that gets it done for you Muse[Video 1](https://muse.ai/videos/avatars/hatch_connecting.mp4)[Video 2](https://muse.ai/videos/avatars/hatch_working.mp4), AI that gets it done for you sorts your email books reservations shops for you saves you money manages calendars builds fitness plans gets it done for you sorts your email![Image 2](https://muse.ai/images/landing/icons/icon-envelope.webp)books reservations![Image 3](https://muse.ai/images/landing/icons/icon-airplane.webp)shops for you![Image 4](https://muse.ai/images/landing/icons/icon-cart.webp)saves you money![Image 5](https://muse.ai/images/landing/icons/icon-piggybank.webp)manages calendars![Image 6](https://muse.ai/images/landing/icons/icon-calendar.webp)builds fitness plans![Image 7](https://muse.ai/images/landing/icons/b-01.webp)gets it done for you

# Log in or create an account

Mobile number or email(required) 

You may receive SMS notifications from us by using your mobile number. [Learn more](https://www.meta.com/help/artificial-intelligence/31983416211257755/)

Continue

[Learn more](https://muse.ai/#landing-introduction-video-title)

## Built around your whole life

Give Muse a goal or task and it handles the rest, from saving money and improving your health to smart shopping and helping you strengthen your relationships.

[Video 3](https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/o1/v/t6/f2/m421/AQPvdntV2G814fVexG62mHy9MLAFz-IUx2_276pwlTOScjlG7403bT1NxrxgW2yToPZR5BOsHoRWgC3EQGGX.mp4?_nc_sid=9c7e41&_nc_ht=scontent.xx.fbcdn.net&ccb=17-1&_nc_gid=1_pv2b7xcPHHwvjhZlxDmw&edm=AIlawRcEAAAA&_nc_zt=28&oh=00_AQOI_RYHB9DeNP-P5WP0FbGO_eDUgdOjz49J3w3LPxHdIA&oe=6AEB38AE#t=1)

### Every Muse user shares their own computer in the cloud with their Muse.

Muse Secure VM is a persistent, isolated Linux computer with a full browser that you and your agent can use to complete tasks, allowing you to intervene at any point. It's your computer and your browser, with the storage, CPU, and memory to handle real work.

![Image 8: Floating browser, search, map, calendar, and confirmation panels](https://muse.ai/images/landing/browser.webp)![Image 9: Floating browser, search, map, calendar, and confirmation panels](https://muse.ai/images/landing/browser-dark.webp)

### Designed around the way you already communicate

Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp. There's no learning curve, just tell Muse what you want to get done.

![Image 10: A chat on a phone where the agent has filled out a school form, shown beside a laptop](https://muse.ai/images/landing/messaging.webp)![Image 11: A chat on a phone where the agent has filled out a school form, shown beside a laptop](https://muse.ai/images/landing/messaging-dark.webp)

### Stay in control of what your agent does

Approve actions your agent takes on your behalf before they happen, like sending emails and making purchases. See a complete audit trail of everything your agent has done (and what it's planning to do).

![Image 12: Floating purchase, message, activity, permission, and decision controls](https://muse.ai/images/landing/approvals.webp)![Image 13: Floating purchase, message, activity, permission, and decision controls](https://muse.ai/images/landing/approvals-dark.webp)

### Your data is kept secure and private

Save your logins to a secure credential store Muse can't see, with 1Password integration coming soon. When shopping, a one-time card number is generated at checkout so your real card stays hidden from the merchant and your agent. Eligible purchases are covered by [Link's purchase protections](https://link.com/protections), a first for AI agents, and your conversations are not shared with Meta's ad systems.

![Image 14: A vault, privacy shield, masked credential, security control, and virtual card](https://muse.ai/images/landing/secure-storage.webp)![Image 15: A vault, privacy shield, masked credential, security control, and virtual card](https://muse.ai/images/landing/secure-storage-dark.webp)

### Proactively helps with your goals and suggests ideas

Muse helps you stay on top of things, takes tasks and projects off your plate, and turns long-term goals into real progress. It learns from conversations, reflects on what matters and gets sharper, coming back with ideas built around what you actually need, ready to act on them under your direction.

![Image 16: Floating checklist, calendar, route, progress, and idea panels](https://muse.ai/images/landing/goals.webp)![Image 17: Floating checklist, calendar, route, progress, and idea panels](https://muse.ai/images/landing/goals-dark.webp)

### Connects to your apps and builds its own tools

Connect the apps you use daily, like email, calendar, and Instagram. You decide what your agent can see and what it can do. If a task needs a tool that doesn't exist, your agent builds it for you.

![Image 18: Connected app, messaging, media, cloud, calendar, and automation tiles](https://muse.ai/images/landing/connectors.webp)

## Get the most out of your Muse

A guided tour of Muse, from setting a first goal to seeing it through.

![Image 19: Product designer presenting a guided tour of Muse](https://muse.ai/images/hatch/landing/product-walkthrough-cover.png)

## Learn more about Muse

Explore the choices behind Muse and how it is built to deserve your trust.

### [How We Designed Muse When Muse works, it feels like magic. These are the product choices that make the experience possible.](https://introducing.muse.ai/)### [How We Built Safety Into Muse Muse is built for privacy, safety, and security. Learn how these principles shape every part of the product.](https://security.muse.ai/)### [Muse for Business Meet the AI agent that works for your small business and keeps jobs moving between your decisions.](https://muse.ai/business)

## Ready to try Muse?

Vice President Kwesi Amissah-Arthur

Former Vice President Kwesi Amissah-Arthur’s brother, Jabesh Amissah-Arthur is quitting as CEO of the Bui Power Authority.  
  
 An internal memo written to BPA staff dated 25 January said: “this is to inform all staff that I will be proceeding on my terminal leave form Friday, 27 January.”  
  
 “While arranging to hand over to the president’s representative as agreed with the Minister, the Director for Programmes and Engineering Department Mr Anthony Boye Osafo-Kissi, will be responsible for the day-to-day administration of the Authority.”  
  
 “Please extend to him your usual corporation,” the former Vice President’s younger brother said in the memo titled: Terminal Leave – Chief Executive Officer.

# 'I wish I could say I'm taking over NDC' - Rawlings

*   [![Image 8: Twitter](https://cdn.ghanaweb.com/design/newtop/X-icon-Col.png)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ghanaweb.com%2FGhanaHomePage%2FNewsArchive%2FI-wish-I-could-say-I-m-taking-over-NDC-Rawlings-504544)

[![Image 9: Jerry John Rawlings, former President of Ghana](https://cdn.ghanaweb.com/imagelib/pics/546/54653994.295.jpg)](https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/I-wish-I-could-say-I-m-taking-over-NDC-Rawlings-504544?gallery=1 [link_46])Jerry John Rawlings, former President of Ghana

Former President Jerry John Rawlings has said he wished he could say he was taking over the main opposition National Democratic Congress (NDC) as being rumoured and claimed that he plans doing.  
  
 “I wish I could say yes, but I think it sounds better in my ear to say that I want God to come and lead us because of the integrity factor. God can be found in the truth,” Mr Rawlings said on Thursday 26 January when the Volta regional caucus of the party in parliament called on him at his office.  
  
 He bemoaned that integrity had been “held hostage” in the NDC and, thus, urged the party to, in candour and truthfulness, seek answers to its loss in the December 2016 general elections.  
  
 The founder of the NDC charged the Volta regional caucus to restore integrity within the NDC, which he said had suffered.  
  
 “It has been ambushed and held hostage. The time has come to free the truth,” the ex-military leader told the caucus members when they called on him at his office.   
  
 Mr Rawlings called for sincerity in speech, thought and action as the party probes its loss. “The time to free the truth is now,” he said.  
  
 “What our supporters need is candour. If you want them to stay united, if you want them to be a little strong, all you can offer them now is candour. Don’t engage in political talk of the past.”  
  
 The former president said the misuse of executive power by some people had, with time, led to the detachment of the party from the people, stating the intoxicating effects of power had made many leaders of the party and government impervious to reality. “We adopted certain habits which were going to lead to failure and we were not seeing it. The mistakes were too obvious,” he stated.  
  
 The Member of Parliament for Ho West, Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzrah, who led the delegation, thanked the former president for the audience and indicated that the purpose of the meeting was to open channels of communication so they could tap into his rich experience.

Title: Dadzie TV on Instagram: "I have never been shy about where I was born. I am proud of my roots.

This evening, tears have been rolling down my face, and I just can’t stop crying. This song is more than music to me. It is a covenant, a constant reminder that I must do something to change my life and the lives of my family.

I want the world to know that even if I should die today, these images will always tell the story that God has a way of changing lives. I am proud of my heritage. I attended school here until Class 6, and I will never forget where my journey began.

God, even if You choose not to bless me with riches or greatness, I have just one prayer. For the sake of my mother and father, please help me change their lives before You call them home. That is my deepest desire. 🙏😭"

# Emmanuel Osei Sarpong appointed Acting NSA Director-General

[October 01, 2026](https://classfmonline.com/sports/Emmanuel-Osei-Sarpong-appointed-Acting-NSA-Director-General-79607)

Sports News

![Image 2](https://cdn.classfmonline.com/imagelib/thumbs/86897420.jpg)Prof. Emmanuel Sarpong

Emmanuel Osei Sarpong has been appointed Acting Director-General of the National Sports Authority (NSA) following the suspension of Yaw Ampofo Ankrah by President John Dramani Mahama.

Mr Sarpong, who is the National Coordinator of the School and Grassroots Sports Secretariat at the Ministry of Sports and Recreation, will oversee the NSA while a Criminal Investigation Department (CID) investigation into allegations involving the authority continues.

A letter dated October 1, 2026, and signed by the Secretary to the President, Dr Calitus Mahama, directed Mr Ankrah to step aside with immediate effect.

The letter stated that the suspension was an administrative measure and did not constitute a finding of wrongdoing against Mr Ankrah.

“His Excellency the President has directed that Mr Yaw Ampofo Ankrah be suspended from his duties as Director-General of the NSA with immediate effect, pending the completion of the investigation by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID),” the letter said.

It added that Mr Sarpong would act as Director-General during the period of the suspension.

The decision follows allegations surrounding an arrangement linked to travel and visa facilitation for prospective travellers seeking to attend the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

According to the allegations, about US$623,000 was received from prospective travellers seeking assistance with visa and travel arrangements. The matter prompted a police investigation, with Mr Ankrah and other individuals connected to the allegations appearing before the CID.

Mr Ankrah appeared before investigators last week and denied wrongdoing. He had also previously denied knowledge of any arrangement involving the collection of money from prospective World Cup travellers.

The NSA has maintained that it did not authorise any visa facilitation service or establish an office to collect money from members of the public seeking to travel to the tournament.

In a statement issued in September, the Authority said its relationship with TRIBE FEST, a FIFA-licensed partner involved in fan-experience activities, World Cup viewing events and mobilisation, did not include authorisation to collect money for visa procurement.

The controversy followed a petition reportedly submitted to the CID on September 8, alleging that individuals connected to the NSA received money from prospective travellers on the understanding that their travel and visa arrangements would be facilitated.

The Minority in Parliament subsequently called for Mr Ankrah to be dismissed or suspended while investigations continued.

The Ranking Member on Parliament's Youth and Sports Committee, Vincent Ekow Assafuah, said information available to the Minority indicated that some prospective travellers were charged as much as US$8,000 for assistance with World Cup travel arrangements.

The Minority also questioned who authorised the alleged arrangement, who received the money and what services were provided.

The NSA, however, rejected the suggestion that the alleged operation was an official arrangement of the Authority. It said no employee had been authorised to collect money or facilitate visas on behalf of the NSA.

The Authority further stated that its legal team was cooperating with the police investigation and that Mr Ankrah and other relevant officials would make themselves available to investigators if required.

Mr Ankrah's suspension therefore takes effect while the CID investigation remains ongoing. The suspension itself does not establish criminal liability or prove the allegations against him.

Mr Sarpong, who is an Associate Professor of Exercise and Sports Science in the Department of Health, Physical Education, Recreation and Sports at the University of Education, Winneba (UEW), will now assume responsibility for the day-to-day administration of the NSA.

The NSA is responsible for the management and development of sports infrastructure and the coordination of sports activities across Ghana.

The latest development comes after President Mahama dissolved the governing board of the NSA on September 2 as part of a wider decision affecting several state institutions. The board was subsequently expected to be reconstituted.

The CID investigation is expected to establish whether money was collected from prospective travellers, who received the funds, what representations were made to those who paid, and whether any public officials or institutions were involved.

# NSA boss Yaw Ampofo Ankrah sacked after 'visa racketeering' allegations

[October 01, 2026](https://classfmonline.com/sports/NSA-boss-Yaw-Ampofo-Ankrah-sacked-after-visa-racketeering-allegations-79606)

Sports News

![Image 2](https://cdn.classfmonline.com/imagelib/thumbs/45241670.jpg)Yaw Ampofo Ankrah was the Director-General of the National Sports Authority

Yaw Ampofo Ankrah, the Director-General of the National Sports Authority (NSA), has reportedly been dismissed by President John Dramani Mahama.

The removal of Yaw Ampofo Ankrah comes following accusations of his involvement in a visa racketeering during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

The NSA boss has vehemently denied the allegations, nonetheless he has been directed to vacate his office.

Emmanuel Osei Sarpong, an Associate Professor of Physical Education and Sports at the University of Education, Winneba (UEW), has been appointed acting Director-General of the NSA.

Background

Yaw Ampofo Ankrah's dismissal comes amid ongoing police investigations into an alleged visa facilitation scheme and other matters regarding the management of Ghana’s sporting facilities.

Pressure on his leadership heightened in September this year after the Minority in Parliament called for his suspension or dismissal over allegations that more than US$600,000 had been collected from individuals seeking assistance with visa and travel arrangements for the World Cup.

The Minority alleged that some applicants were charged as much as US$8,000.

Mr Ampofo Ankrah and other NSA officials are reported to have been interrogated by the Criminal Investigations Department of the Ghana Police Service as part of the investigations into the Minority's allegations.

![Image 9: CEO of Korle Bu Teaching Hospital, Dr Gilbert Buckle](https://cdn.ghanaweb.com/imagelib/pics/803/80371075.jpg)CEO of Korle Bu Teaching Hospital, Dr Gilbert Buckle

The Korle Bu Senior Staff Association (KOSSA) wants the new government to sack Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Dr Gilbert Buckle as well as some other senior management officials and the Board.  
  
 In a statement signed by Vice-President of KOSSA, Mr Augustine Sowah, the senior staff said “the way to resolve” the rot at the referral facility is “to interdict the CEO, the Director of Finance and the Internal Auditor and constitute a new board with immediate effect.”  
  
 KOSSA’s agitation follows a recent controversy in which the CEO is accused of paying himself and a few management members more than GHS150,000 as Christmas bonus.  
  
 The staff say they are “very surprised” that the immediate past government’s appointees to the board are today “claiming innocence of the outrageous payments allegedly made by the Dr Buckle management to itself”.  
  
 “We at KOSSA do not believe this. But we ask, since when did Prof Mawuli Sallar and his board lose confidence in Dr Buckle and his leadership style? When we raised the preventive red flags about Dr Buckle, did he and his board not rubbish it and come after us?”  
  
 The staff made reference to some caution letters they had earlier sent to the board and former Health Minister Alex Segbefia to warn its members about the CEO’s actions.  
  
 “We wish to refer Ghanaians to two main letters and reports: the first was dated April 16, 2016, and expressly addressed to Mr Segbefia, with the heading: Acts of impunity by the Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital board and management.  
  
 “Prof Sallar’s board is mentioned because we tried to help him understand the plots but it looked as if there was either a political motive or sectional interest he pursued, culminating in this recent disaster from which he now wants to extricate himself,” it said.

[![Image 9: Dr. Dominic Obeng-Andoh, owner of Obengfo Medical Centre](https://cdn.ghanaweb.com/imagelib/pics/818/81818950.295.jpg)](https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Obengfo-Medical-Centre-shut-down-504564?gallery=1)Dr. Dominic Obeng-Andoh, owner of Obengfo Medical Centre

The Obengfo Medical Centre at Weija in Accra has been shut down by the Ghana Medical and Dental Council.  
  
 According to the medical Council, operators of the centre do not have the requisite licence to carry out their activities.  
  
 An attempt to shut the facility down earlier this month failed as patients and staff of the centre physically fought off efforts by the team that went to undertake the exercise.  
  
 Starr News’ Atiewin Mbillah-Lawson who witnessed the shut down Friday said a single door, has however, been left open for patients already on admission to exit the facility.  
  
 Efforts by the administrator Dr. Dominic Obeng-Andoh to quash a court order to close down his facility was thwarted as it was discovered that his lawyer’s practicing license had expired.  
  
 Meanwhile, he told StarrFMonline.com in an earlier interview that he is only being witch-hunted by some individuals within the medical council.  
  
 “I’m not operating illegally, but there are issues… and these are diabolic actions to frustrate me.  
  
 “This is sheer jealousy. I’m actually doing what no doctor is really doing and I have advanced the level. I get clients that no doctor is getting and receiving people some doctors are not getting; celebrities, journalists, doctors and international people from the US, UK among others,” he stated.

Private legal practitioner, Martin Kpebu, during an interview with TV3, shared how he voted for and openly endorsed former President [](https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/people/person.php?ID=253)[Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo](https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/people/person.php?ID=253) during the 2016 general elections.  
  
 According to him, his decision to vote for Akufo-Addo was not one of regret, as he explained the reasons behind his choice.  
  
 Kpebu stated that at the time, he did not want to see Mahama return to power, which led him to support Akufo-Addo's candidacy.  
  
 “I’m somebody that voted for Nana. I was in favor of Nana coming in 2016 because I didn’t want JM to get a second term. The Board of Electricity Company (ECG), chaired by MP and Majority Leader of Parliament Alexander Afenyo-Markin, has assured the national power distribution company will operate without any challenge in spite of the untimely resignation of Managing Director (MD), Mr Samuel Dubik Mahama.  
  
 According Mr Afenyo-Markin, the company is intact and will continue to operate without any glitch.  
  
 He gave the assurance speaking after an emegency meeting of the board to allay the fears of Ghanaians following Mr Mahama's resignation tendered in yesterday, September 25, 2024.   
  
 Mr Afenyo-Markin, also, announced an acting MD called David Asamoah had been appointed to the office, ahead of government appointing a substantive MD.  
  
 The NPP MP said the decision for Mr Asamoah to act as MD was to ensure the smooth running of ECG.   
  
 He said the board had accepted the resignation of the outgone MD.  
  
 He called on Ghanaians to detach politics from the operations of ECG to ensure its efficient running.

CEO of the National Petroleum Authority, Moses Asaga](https://cdn.ghanaweb.com/imagelib/pics/394/39423794.295.jpg)](https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/NPA-Akufo-Addo-fires-Asaga-hires-Tampuli-504579?gallery=1)Fmr. CEO of the National Petroleum Authority, Moses Asaga

CEO of the National Petroleum Authority (NPA), Moses Asaga has been sacked by President Nana Akufo-Addo.  
  
 He has been replaced by legal practitioner Hassan Tampuli as care-taker CEO until a substantive CEO is appointed, according to a letter dated 26 January and signed by Energy Minister-designate Boakye Agyarko.  
  
 “As a care-taker CEO, you will not take decisions that have policy implications until a substantive Governing Board is in place,” the letter noted.  
  
 "You may refer such policy related decisions to the Ministry for prior approval," the letter noted.

Vice President Kwesi Amissah-Arthur

Former Vice President Kwesi Amissah-Arthur’s brother, Jabesh Amissah-Arthur is quitting as CEO of the Bui Power Authority.  
  
 An internal memo written to BPA staff dated 25 January said: “this is to inform all staff that I will be proceeding on my terminal leave form Friday, 27 January.”  
  
 “While arranging to hand over to the president’s representative as agreed with the Minister, the Director for Programmes and Engineering Department Mr Anthony Boye Osafo-Kissi, will be responsible for the day-to-day administration of the Authority.”  
  
 “Please extend to him your usual corporation,” the former Vice President’s younger brother said in the memo titled: Terminal Leave – Chief Executive Officer.

CEO of the National Petroleum Authority, Moses Asaga](https://cdn.ghanaweb.com/imagelib/pics/394/39423794.295.jpg)](https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/NPA-Akufo-Addo-fires-Asaga-hires-Tampuli-504579?gallery=1)Fmr. CEO of the National Petroleum Authority, Moses Asaga

CEO of the National Petroleum Authority (NPA), Moses Asaga has been sacked by President Nana Akufo-Addo.  
  
 He has been replaced by legal practitioner Hassan Tampuli as care-taker CEO until a substantive CEO is appointed, according to a letter dated 26 January and signed by Energy Minister-designate Boakye Agyarko.  
  
 “As a care-taker CEO, you will not take decisions that have policy implications until a substantive Governing Board is in place,” the letter noted.  
  
 "You may refer such policy related decisions to the Ministry for prior approval," the letter noted.

The Board of Electricity Company (ECG), chaired by MP and Majority Leader of Parliament Alexander Afenyo-Markin, has assured the national power distribution company will operate without any challenge in spite of the untimely resignation of Managing Director (MD), Mr Samuel Dubik Mahama.  
  
 According Mr Afenyo-Markin, the company is intact and will continue to operate without any glitch.  
  
 He gave the assurance speaking after an emegency meeting of the board to allay the fears of Ghanaians following Mr Mahama's resignation tendered in yesterday, September 25, 2024.   
  
 Mr Afenyo-Markin, also, announced an acting MD called David Asamoah had been appointed to the office, ahead of government appointing a substantive MD.  
  
 The NPP MP said the decision for Mr Asamoah to act as MD was to ensure the smooth running of ECG.   
  
 He said the board had accepted the resignation of the outgone MD.  
  
 He called on Ghanaians to detach politics from the operations of ECG to ensure its efficient running.

# NSA boss Yaw Ampofo Ankrah sacked after 'visa racketeering' allegations

[October 01, 2026](https://classfmonline.com/sports/NSA-boss-Yaw-Ampofo-Ankrah-sacked-after-visa-racketeering-allegations-79606)

Sports News

![Image 2](https://cdn.classfmonline.com/imagelib/thumbs/45241670.jpg)Yaw Ampofo Ankrah was the Director-General of the National Sports Authority

Yaw Ampofo Ankrah, the Director-General of the National Sports Authority (NSA), has reportedly been dismissed by President John Dramani Mahama.

The removal of Yaw Ampofo Ankrah comes following accusations of his involvement in a visa racketeering during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

The NSA boss has vehemently denied the allegations, nonetheless he has been directed to vacate his office.

Emmanuel Osei Sarpong, an Associate Professor of Physical Education and Sports at the University of Education, Winneba (UEW), has been appointed acting Director-General of the NSA.

Background

Yaw Ampofo Ankrah's dismissal comes amid ongoing police investigations into an alleged visa facilitation scheme and other matters regarding the management of Ghana’s sporting facilities.

Pressure on his leadership heightened in September this year after the Minority in Parliament called for his suspension or dismissal over allegations that more than US$600,000 had been collected from individuals seeking assistance with visa and travel arrangements for the World Cup.

The Minority alleged that some applicants were charged as much as US$8,000.

Mr Ampofo Ankrah and other NSA officials are reported to have been interrogated by the Criminal Investigations Department of the Ghana Police Service as part of the investigations into the Minority's allegations.

Title: Africa Fintech Summit on Instagram: "Progress in fintech requires patience on both sides.

Kwame Oppong, Director of FinTech & Innovation at the Bank of Ghana, emphasized that while the industry moves fast, regulators carry a broader responsibility in ensuring safety and stability for the entire economy.

That’s why meaningful progress comes from continuous engagement, even when the conversations are difficult. It’s through this process that new ideas like discussing cryptocurrency within central banking become possible.

Innovation doesn’t move forward by avoiding friction. It moves forward by working through it.

These are the kinds of honest, sometimes uncomfortable discussions that shape the next phase of fintech policy across Africa and will continue at Africa Fintech Summit Washington D.C. 2026.

April 16, 2026 — Washington, D.C.
Register via Link in Bio. 🔗

#AFTSDC2026 #AfricaFintech #FintechPolicy #CentralBanking #Innovation"

Gemini 4 Argon delivers frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense.

[Learn more](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-argon/?utm_source=about.google&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=homepagehero)

## Our Project Suncatcher satellite is now in orbit

Our prototype satellite launched into orbit — the first step in our moonshot to put AI in space.

[Blast off](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-research/project-suncatcher-prototype?utm_source=about.google&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=homepage)

Title: Africa Fintech Summit on Instagram: "Scale in financial markets is about more than the size of a balance sheet.

During Unstoppable Africa 2026, Ms. Nonkululeko Nyembezi, Chairperson of Standard Bank Group, explained how scale gives financial institutions greater agency when engaging global capital and navigating challenges such as currency mismatches, hard currency constraints, and liquidity.

A strong balance sheet may provide the ticket to participate, but successfully structuring a transaction requires the capabilities around it to manage complexity and bring projects to completion.

Capital gets you into the game; the ability to navigate complexity is what gets the transaction done.
